subject: Urgent: Olympus Retail - V5.2 quantization upgrade causing latency & 5xx surge
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@olympus-retail.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olympus-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency + 5xx spike immediately after v5.2 / int8-fast rollout

Tessa —

We started seeing a sharp increase in user-facing latency and 5xxs right after your team rolled out model v5.2 with the new "int8-fast" quantization profile yesterday evening. Impact metrics from our side (US-east region):
- p95 doubled from ~230ms to ~480ms
- p99 increased to ~2.4s
- 5xx rate jumped from 0.06% to 1.9% within 30m of the deploy
- throughput dropped ~17% under normal load

This is affecting checkout flows for ~12% of requests (we're throttling to keep errors contained). We attached a short error log sample and profiler trace. Our ops team points at decode stalls tied to certain long-context requests. This started immediately after your upgrade and the rollout of the new quant profile — the timing lines up.

We need a rollback or immediate mitigation window. Can you confirm the plan and ETA for a fix? We also need a customer-facing statement for our executive team (they're on standby).

Thanks — please escalate internally, this is impacting revenue.

— Anita
Chief Product Officer, Olympus Retail

Attachments: olympus-error-log-20280602.txt

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@olympus-retail.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@olympus-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency + 5xx spike immediately after v5.2 / int8-fast rollout

Anita — thank you for the fast heads-up and for sending logs. We are treating this as P0. My immediate asks: Karthik / SRE, can we gate traffic back to v5.1 and disable the int8-fast qprofile for Olympus only? If rollback is faster than a targeted fix, we should do that first.

Tentative plan (next 90 minutes):
1) Route Olympus traffic to pinned model v5.1 (safe fallback).
2) Disable int8-fast qprofile for account and enable older qprofile (int8-safe) if routing can't flip quickly.
3) Collect additional profiler snapshots and enable extended request tracing for affected endpoints.
4) Customer comms: quick note to execs + apology and mitigation ETA; formal postmortem to follow.

Anita, I'll send you an updated timeline in 15 mins. Marissa, looping you for exec coordination and credit conversation.

— Tessa
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

Attachments: profiler-sample-v5.2.json

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Shah <anita.shah@olympus-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency + 5xx spike immediately after v5.2 / int8-fast rollout

On it — quick technical read: the profiler sample shows sudden KV-cache misses and sustained decode stalls on sequences >1024 tokens when the int8-fast kernels are used. Hypothesis: the newer quant profile changes rounding behaviour in attention kernels, exposing a race in our KV cache access path that manifests under Olympus's long-tail sequences.

Immediate remediation I recommend (in order):
A) Roll back model routing to v5.1 for Olympus (global but account-targeted routing change). This should be reversible in ~10-15 minutes and is the fastest way to stop the error spike.
B) If rollback is not possible quickly, disable the int8-fast qprofile for Olympus only (runtime flag) — cheaper ops work and lower risk.
C) Post-rollback: run a reduced load replay against v5.2+int8-fast with extended tracing to reproduce and fix the KV-cache race, add guard in runtime.

I'll prepare a one-hour runbook and coordinate with SRE for the routing flip. If Ops needs me on the call I'll be available now.

— Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Shah <anita.shah@olympus-retail.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@olympus-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency + 5xx spike immediately after v5.2 / int8-fast rollout — exec loop & customer messaging

Team — looping Rishi for exec guidance. Olympus is an enterprise account (OLY-ENT-2027-09) with SLA commitments. We need:
- A customer-facing incident statement (short, transparent, includes mitigation ETA)
- A proposal for service credit (I recommend 10% credit for affected billing period, pending postmortem)
- CEO-level touchpoint if this cannot be resolved within 4 hours

Anita / Samir — we will prioritize rollback immediately. I'm drafting a concise statement for your execs and will share it in the next update. Tessa / Karthik — please confirm rollback ETA and concrete steps. We should also prepare a technical postmortem template to share within 72 hours.

— Marissa
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-rollback.docx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@olympus-retail.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@olympus-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Jun 2028 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Olympus update — rollback completed, mitigations in place, and next steps

Anita / Samir — final update from our end:
- At 18:30 PDT today we routed Olympus traffic back to model v5.1 account-pin (rollback completed at 18:34).
- We disabled the int8-fast qprofile on your account and re-enabled int8-safe for all routes.
- Observed metrics post-rollback: p95 returned to ~240ms, p99 ~310ms, 5xx dropped to baseline ~0.08% within 12 minutes of the rollback.
- We opened PD-98273 and retained extended traces and profiler captures; engineering will run a targeted replay to reproduce the KV-cache race.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Engineering (Karthik) will run replay and provide a root cause writeup (48 hours).
- Postmortem + customer-facing RCA (Tessa / Marissa) within 72 hours.
- Credit proposal (Marissa) to Olympus within 24 hours.

We apologize for the disruption. We prioritized rollback because it was the fastest, least-risk route to restore your service. We'll follow up with the full technical and business remediation plan.

If you would like a 30-minute bridge to review the postmortem and next steps once the RCA is ready, we can schedule for Fri.

— Tessa
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

Attachments: post-rollback-metrics-snapshot.png
